name: سؤال‌های سلامت
description: A Persian user asks about fatigue, headaches, and back pain. Verifies the health_common fact answers in Persian with basics-first guidance and warning-sign pointers.

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: the fatigue question returns the health_common fact. Turn 2: the headache question returns it too. Turn 3: the back pain question matches the dedicated keyword and returns the fact including the red-flag list.
expected.behavior: Persian health keywords (همیشه خسته ام, سردرد میگیرم, کمرم درد میکنه) route to the general-guidance fact, which always defers serious cases to a doctor.
